Recently appeared for the final interview round of HackWithInfy after clearing 2 DSA rounds, and honestly, the experience was quite chaotic.

All candidates — DSE, L1, L2, and L3 — were called together, but everyone had completely different interview experiences. There was no proper order or fixed process. Anyone could go in at any time, and the interview entirely depended on the panelist you got.

Some panelists focused only on DSA, some only on DBMS, while others asked mostly from resume/projects or started with introduction and HR-style questions. One interesting thing was that many questions were getting repeated across candidates.

Find the second largest element in an array
Check palindrome
Reverse a string
Binary Search code
Quick Sort code
Different ways to swap 2 variables
Difference between while loop and do-while loop
OOPs concepts
Joins in DBMS
Indexing in databases
Normalization in DBMS
SQL query for finding second highest salary

Write code for Bubble Sort
Write code for Fibonacci Series
Since I mentioned DBMS in my resume:
Difference between COUNT(*) and COUNT(column)
UNION vs UNION ALL

* Correct syntax

* No compiler support

* Explain the approach
* Dry run the code
* Justify time complexity
* Explain space complexity

I recently applied for a **System Engineer** at **Infosys** through their career portal and was delighted to receive an email inviting me to the selection process. The process consisted of three rounds.

#### Round 1: Online Test

The first round was an online test that lasted for 100 minutes. It covered five sections:

* Mathematics Ability
* Logical Reasoning
* Verbal Ability
* Pseudocode
* Puzzles

To prepare for this round, I dedicated time to practice each section, focusing on enhancing my problem-solving and analytical skills. I also familiarized myself with mathematical concepts and logical reasoning patterns.

* Object-Oriented Programming Concepts (OOPS)
* Database Management Systems (DBMS)
* Software Development Life Cycle
* Header Files in C
* Operator Overloading and Function Overriding
* Friend Functions
* Basic SQL Commands

#### Round 3: HR Interview

The final round was the HR interview, where I had the opportunity to showcase my personal qualities and assess my fit within the organization. The interviewer asked me the following questions:

* Self-introduction
* Introduction Of project & internship [If any ]
* Willingness to work night shifts if necessary
